purpose: Cross-skill regression assertions for shared protocol consistency.

assertions.rule: SOURCE enum includes UNKNOWN and specialists must not guess SOURCE.
Brief final handoff must support Creative Exploration Specialist / Product Innovation Specialist / Other and must preserve HOLD.
Creative and Product formal cases require source audit fields and permit UNVERIFIED without promoting to strong evidence.
Creative and Product Selection Gate explicitly allow KEEP NONE.
Product Innovation encodes INNOVATION REOPEN and BRIEF REOPEN as separate failure branches.
Cross-workstream field name is CROSS-WORKSTREAM SIGNALS; legacy CREATIVE SIGNAL / PRODUCT INNOVATION SIGNAL must not be used as shared field names.
Proposal may not infer SOURCE, may not equate logic coherence with SUPPORTED, and may not declare R&D/Pilot readiness without feasibility constraints.
Project Hub provides a no-file-write fallback through PROJECT STATE BLOCK and checks minimum handoff integrity.

Proposal Development is routed and described as developing an existing Strategy / Idea / Innovation Direction into a complete proposal file; client decision is a diagnostic consideration, not the product definition.

Creative formal cases in ROUND 1 / ROUND 2 require at least one authentic execution visual plus traceable SOURCE LINK and VISUAL SOURCE LINK; cases missing reliable visual or link stay in TO SOURCE / BACKUP and AI/stock/logo/packshot cannot substitute for real case visuals.

Creative supports direct Concept Development from a user-selected Idea Seed; existing mascot/IP/collab/packaging/activation/KOL/media ideas are treated as EXECUTION HYPOTHESES until the core concept passes Human Truth, Brand Right, Task/Moment, semantic-boundary and creative-requirement checks. Full Execution/IMC is downstream of CONCEPT READY.

Project Hub is the single source of VERSION / UPDATE PROTOCOL: GitHub main is canonical, freshness check is triggered when explicitly requested, source is unknown, or last known check exceeds 7 days; updates are never silently applied; all four Specialists inherit this rule rather than redefining it; true weekly polling requires external automation.
